description.value: Edgemount Guesthouse is a single private suite added onto a historic home in Field, BC, situated within Yoho National Park just 27 km from Lake Louise. The self-contained second-floor suite features an open-concept layout with a full kitchen, queen bed, claw-foot bath, and a balcony with BBQ and mountain views. Field is an exceptional staging point for cyclists exploring the surrounding national parks, with access to the Icefields Parkway, Banff, and the UNESCO World Heritage landscapes of Yoho.
